g.text: U1 is a 4049 hex inverter. The doc: CD4049UBE (unbuffered) gives slightly more normal sounds, MC14049BCPG

g.desc: U1 is a 4049 hex inverter. The doc: CD4049UBE (unbuffered) gives slightly more normal sounds, MC14049BCPG

g.text: (buffered) is glitchier; try both, socket it.

g.desc: (buffered) is glitchier; try both, socket it.

g.text: Power Starve: the chip's VSS (pin 8) goes to ground through the 100k pot and 1k, not straight to GND. The

g.desc: Power Starve: the chip's VSS (pin 8) goes to ground through the 100k pot and 1k, not straight to GND. The

g.text: unused inputs 7 and 9 sit on that starved VSS, their outputs 6 and 10 open.

g.desc: unused inputs 7 and 9 sit on that starved VSS, their outputs 6 and 10 open.

g.text: The sheet's 'Pin 1' and 'Pin 8' dots are U1's VDD and VSS; the dot marked NC past pin 15 is the end of that
